title: Identifying predictors of student depression through validated machine learning pipelines.
summary: Using 27,901 student-depression records, the paper compares fixed-parameter and optimized learning-curve pipelines. Only the optimized pipeline shows monotonic validation improvement/convergence; its feature ranking places suicidal-thought history, academic pressure and financial stress highest. This is a source-specific finding about model-validity and correlates, not causal risk factors. Published in Frontiers in Medicine.
